name: 둘 DUL PAY
tagline: A Seoul money app that feels effortless

brief.name: Dul Pay
brief.industry: A Korean consumer money app — transfers, splitting bills, spending insights, and a debit card — bright, friendly, and effortless
brief.audience: Koreans 20-39 who expect best-in-class mobile UX; students splitting meals, young professionals, first-jobbers. Korean (Hangul) first, English secondary.
brief.references: Toss (토스), KakaoPay, Naver Pay, Baemin (배민) playfulness, Musinsa polish
brief.context: Hangul-first copy using Pretendard (load via jsDelivr) or Noto Sans KR (Google Fonts), with generous line-height. High-contrast white/ink base + one confident accent (Toss-blue / Baemin-mint feel). Hero with a phone mockup + one-line promise, feature cards with smooth micro-interactions, a card/fees section, and app-store CTA. Tidy hierarchy, rounded modern UI, subtle spring motion.
brief.avoid: K-pop neon or palace/hanbok motifs as the theme. Cluttered layouts. Hangul in a fallback font with bad spacing. Cold enterprise tone. English-only.
